errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по размер, като най-големият е "да", следван от "не мога да преценя" и най-малкият е "не".
errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are arranged by size. However, the visual arrangement of the sectors in the pie chart does not follow a descending or ascending order. Starting from the top and going clockwise, the percentages are 25%, 11%, and 64%, which is not an ordered sequence.
